title: Step By Step
description:
Step By Step, Inc. is a private nonprofit human services organization established in 1977 and headquartered in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania. The organization provides community-based support services to individuals with intellectual and physical disabilities, autism, mental health disorders, and substance use disorders. Its services include residential programs, vocational and employment support, behavioral health and counseling, autism services, in-home and community support, and other individualized programs designed to promote independence and community participation. Step By Step serves more than 2,000 individuals across multiple regions and more than a dozen Pennsylvania counties. The organization works with individuals, families, and community partners to provide personalized support throughout different stages of life. 
The company headquarters is located in 744 Kidder Street, Wilkes-Barre, PA 18702, United States.
1K-5K Employees
